info.name: Nextcloud Test SQL
info.summary: DANGEROUS test-only app that exposes parameterized SQL over HTTP
info.description:
# DANGER: NEVER USE IN PRODUCTION
Nextcloud Test SQL exposes HTTP endpoints that can read or make arbitrary changes to the Nextcloud database. It is exclusively intended for disposable end-to-end test containers.
Requests require a per-container access key configured through `occ config:app:set`. Enabling this app on a production system can cause data loss or complete compromise of the Nextcloud database.
info.author: Sebastian Müller
